headline: PINBALL: the magnet holds its pack
lede: Multiball met the magnet one ball at a time. The coil now stays hot through a hold — every ball that reaches the post face while one is pinned gets caught too, each on its own clock, each snapping free with its own payout.

notes.text: POLISH #3422 shipped via PR #3425 (never-dry rung: idle-kick named PINBALL weakest at score 3; the tilt-muffle gap above it awaits Jon's #3335, so the stage took the next honest gap).

Per-ball all the way down: snap payouts, spent markers (no riding the same drive twice), and the ball search — a stuck free ball is now searched out even while the magnet holds another. The orbit lane turned out per-ball already; it is now pinned so it can't regress.

288/288 pins and 19/19 mutants die, five new; single-ball flow is bit-identical to before (all 279 pre-existing pins passed untouched). Two of my first new pins were vacuously true — a survivor re-caught mid-field beat any flag-read for proof.
